messages:
Maya (Growth): Heads up — final preflight for next week's webinar. Need a tiny checklist for reg page, Zoom recording config, and post-event replay routing. Can we lock this down today? :spiral_calendar:
Leo (Marketing Ops): I can update the reg page CTA + confirmation email. Do we want the replay gated or open?
Priya (Events): Prefer gated for lead quality, but keep a 24hr auto-unlock for non-enterprise recipients. That reduces manual ops.
Sam (Design): I'll push the smaller hero with the 3 benefit bullets and the 2-step CTA (Register -> Confirm email). Need copy from Maya.
Maya (Growth): Copy: "Join us to see real-world latency and cost tradeoffs — plus Q&A with eng." Short subject for email: "You're registered — webinar replay inside"
Alex (DevEx): Zoom settings I recommend (we should set these in the meeting template):
```
- Cloud recording: Record to cloud (separate audio and gallery)
- Auto-join: disabled
- Participant screen share: host only
- Closed captions: enabled (Zoom auto-captions)
- Alternative hosts: @Priya
- Record disclaimer: opt-in in confirmation email
```
Nina (A11y): Please enable live captions + upload transcript after processing. Also set the recording to include separate audio tracks so ASR works better.
Priya (Events): I'll be alt-host. Can someone confirm we have enough cloud recording storage? @Leo
Leo (Marketing Ops): Yes — dedicated bucket for webinars, quota set to 500GB for March. I'll monitor.
Maya (Growth): Replay handling: gated for 48 hours, then public. Zap flow: registrant -> confirmed -> post-event email with gated link -> if opened -> add to nurture list; if not opened -> 2-day reminder.
Alex (DevEx): Zap snippet (high level):
```
Trigger: Zoom registrant created -> Action: Webhook to marketing endpoint (/webhooks/webinar) -> Action: Send transactional email via SendGrid -> Action: Add to CRM list (tag: webinar-2028)
```
Sam (Design): For the gated replay page, I'll add an obvious transcript download button and a CTA for "Request demo".
Nina (A11y): Also include skip-to-content anchor and ensure transcript is plain text + structured headings.
ReplayBot: Recording processed: transcript ready (automated). Link: https://replay.internal.redwood/webinars/latency-tradeoffs-2028 (will be gated until 48h post-event)
Leo (Marketing Ops): Workflow notes: 1) Confirmation email must include privacy/recording note and explicit checkbox for sharing clip snippets. 2) Add UTM params to replay link: utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=latency-2028
Maya (Growth): Metrics post-event: watch conversion from replay open -> demo request, and token usage on docs page linked from replay. @analytics-bot can you surface baseline?
analytics-bot: I'll pull last 6 webinars' replay open -> demo conversion by EOD and post in this thread.
Priya (Events): One more ops check: who handles clipping for the highlights (60-90s)? Sam or Marketing?
Sam (Design): I can export rough clips but would prefer Marketing Ops to finalize CTAs on clips.
Leo (Marketing Ops): I'll own clip gating + tagging in the asset library. Will need timestamps for top moments — can someone collect during the event?
Maya (Growth): I'll flag top 3 moments live. Priya will drop the timestamp markers in #event-live.
Nina (A11y): Quick accessibility test checklist (to confirm before go-live): captions on, transcript uploaded, video player keyboard focusable, alt text for any slide images.
Priya (Events): All set — I'll run through a dry run tomorrow at 10am PT. Zoom link will be same template.
Maya (Growth): Thanks all — if no blockers, Leo can merge reg page edits at 5pm today and I'll approve the email. :thumbsup:
